about_the_game:
Welcome to Pixelpolis Neon, a playful retro city-building experience inspired by classics like SimCity 2000, reimagined in a neon-lit cyberpunk setting. Step into a glowing synthwave world, where creativity is the key to shaping your very own pixel metropolis.

Build across 10 handcrafted maps (100x100 tiles each), each offering a fresh canvas for your ideas. With more than 400 unique buildings, all lovingly drawn by hand — no AI shortcuts here — you can design dazzling skylines, bustling districts, and neon-soaked streets that feel alive.

While the focus is on creative placement and visual storytelling, there’s just enough challenge to keep you engaged: balance your population and goods, unlock bonus buildings, and advance through levels as your city thrives.

Every corner of Pixelpolis Neon is infused with personality: from its vibrant pink-teal synthwave palette contrasting against the dark futuristic backdrop, to its immersive synthwave and dreamwave soundtrack, designed to keep you in the flow while your city expands.

So grab your grid, place your first block, and watch your Pixelpolis Neon come alive in a world where retro charm and cyberpunk vibes collide.

NOTE: The current Pixelpolis Neon version is not much more than a simple city-scape builder (like Dystopika). But after many requests for deeper gameplay, I’m now adding game mechanics. The coming version will feature a society system with social groups that influence how districts look. So far, there will be the Punks (Pink), the Cyborgs (Blue), and the Traditionals (Yellow). You will be able to support (or ignore) the needs of each group to shape your city-scape.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000, AMD Vega 3, or newer)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: default
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Entry-level dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 950 / AMD R7 370 or newer, OR modern integrated GPU like Intel Iris Xe)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: default

short_description: Pixelpolis Neon is a retro-isometric city builder set in a vibrant cyberpunk future. Place over 400 hand-drawn pixel art buildings, balance population and available goods, and craft your own neon-lit dream city to the sound of pulsating synthwave.
